'''Dantaree''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] often hired by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. She assisted Rebel survivors of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] siege of [[Edan Base]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].
